entry.title: New: Resolution 416 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
URGES THE MAYOR AND THE DIRECTOR OF PUBLIC WORKS TO REMOVE PARCELS UNDER THE JURISDICTION OF THE DEPARTMENT OF HAWAIIAN HOME LANDS FROM CONSIDERATION WHEN STUDYING THE FEASIBILITY OF A PUNA MAKAI ALTERNATE ROUTE

Urges that the Puna Makai Alternate Route not connect to the homestead communities of Pana‘ewa and Keaukaha, and that additional funds be provided to broaden the scope to examine potential alternate routes in communities directly mauka of Highway 130, such as ‘Āinaloa and Orchidland.
